convert_imagewise_to_webdataset: convert a BOP imagewise dataset directory to webdataset shard format with configurable max images per shard
run_converter_cli: run the CLI tool with --input and --output flags to convert imagewise datasets to webdataset shards
convert_with_shuffling: convert imagewise to webdataset with --shuffle and --seed flags to randomly shuffle images before sharding
convert_multiprocess: convert imagewise to webdataset using --nprocs flag to parallelize shard creation across multiple subprocesses
make_key_to_shard_map: build a mapping from image keys to shard IDs by scanning existing webdataset shard tar files
